description:
This cloud engineering course teaches you to design and run systems on Amazon Web Services, following the topics of the AWS Certified Solutions Architect – Associate exam.

Banks, fintechs, telcos and start-ups in Nigeria are moving their systems to the cloud, and AWS is the most widely used platform. Teams need people who can choose the right services, connect them securely and keep the bill under control. This programme walks through each area of AWS in the order an architect thinks about it, with scenarios that mirror the decisions you would make at work.

## What the cloud engineering course covers

- **Getting started.** Setting up an account safely with budgets and MFA, the AWS CLI and CloudShell, Regions, Availability Zones, edge locations and the shared responsibility model.
- **Identity and access.** IAM users, groups, roles and policies, least privilege, AWS Organizations, IAM Identity Center, Control Tower and Directory Service.
- **Compute.** EC2 instance types and pricing options, Lambda, ECS, Fargate and container images.
- **Scaling and load balancing.** Application and Network Load Balancers, health checks, launch templates and Auto Scaling policies.
- **Networking.** VPCs, public and private subnets, route tables, gateways, security groups and network ACLs, VPC peering, Site-to-Site VPN and Direct Connect.
- **Storage and databases.** S3 storage classes, policies, versioning, lifecycle rules and replication; EBS and EFS; RDS, Aurora, DynamoDB, DAX and ElastiCache.
- **Migration and analytics.** DataSync, Transfer Family, the Snow Family, DMS and Storage Gateway; Athena, Kinesis, Glue, EMR and QuickSight.
- **Operations and security.** CloudWatch, CloudTrail and Config; KMS, Secrets Manager, WAF, Shield, GuardDuty, Macie, Inspector and Security Hub; CloudFormation and Systems Manager.
- **Architecture.** Route 53 routing policies, CloudFront, SQS, SNS, EventBridge and Step Functions, backup and disaster recovery strategies, cost management and the six pillars of the Well-Architected Framework.

## How the programme works

You follow a guided 12-week plan that sets weekly goals: a group of short video lessons, practice straight after each one and a quiz at the end of every chapter. Each quiz is drawn from the lessons you have just watched, and every answer comes with a short explanation, so a wrong answer teaches you something instead of just costing you marks. If your weeks are unpredictable you can learn at your own pace instead, though most learners finish sooner with the plan.

Quizzes are written like short exam scenarios: a requirement, a constraint and four plausible designs. Learning to spot the deciding detail, such as lowest cost, least operational effort or fastest recovery, is the skill both the AWS exam and real architecture work reward. A final module covers exam strategy and booking.

## Tools you will use

You will use the AWS Management Console, the AWS CLI, CloudShell and CloudFormation. Many labs fit within the AWS Free Tier, but some services are billed, so the course shows you how to set a budget and alerts before you start and how to clean up afterwards.

## Who it is for

The programme suits developers and IT professionals moving into cloud roles, system administrators who manage on-premises servers today and graduates with some IT background who want a clear route to an AWS certification. Familiarity with basic networking and the command line helps; cloud ideas are explained from the ground up.

## After you finish

You will be able to design a secure, highly available architecture on AWS, explain the trade-offs between services and estimate what it will cost. You will also be prepared to sit the AWS Solutions Architect – Associate exam, which you book and pay for separately with AWS.

## Certificate and final exam

When you are ready, you can get your SkillsAir certificate. Once it is unlocked, you sit a timed final exam drawn from every chapter of the programme. Pass it and your certificate is issued with a verification link that employers and clients can check. Certified graduates can also apply for internship openings from our growing partner network, with no job guarantees.

Every learner also gets the free Freelancer’s Academy bonus course, which shows you how to set up a professional Fiverr profile and gigs so you can start finding paying clients for your new skills.

faq.question: Does this prepare me for an AWS certification?
faq.answer: Yes. The modules follow the topics of the AWS Certified Solutions Architect – Associate exam and include a module on exam strategy. You book and pay for the exam separately with AWS.

faq.question: Will the labs cost money?
faq.answer: Many labs fit within the AWS Free Tier, but some services are billed. The course shows you how to set budgets and alerts first and how to delete resources when you finish.

faq.question: Do I need programming skills?
faq.answer: No. You will use the console, the command line and templates. Some IT background, such as basic networking, makes the programme easier to follow.

faq.question: Does it cover Azure or Google Cloud?
faq.answer: No. The programme focuses on AWS. Most cloud concepts, such as networks, identity and scaling, transfer to other providers.

faq.question: Will I get a job after the course?
faq.answer: There are no job guarantees, but you will finish ready for the associate exam with practical architecture skills. Certified graduates can apply for internship openings from our partner network.
